我来填坑了_(:з」∠)_

[color=#ff7700]重要的事写在前面[/color]：这次更新[color=#ff7700]不包括[/color]男性的上衣和下装！！！只更新了[color=#ff7700]8个头饰（帽子）和三个头发[/color]！！！

预览图主要是为了展示头发和帽子的各个角度，并不代表衣服的最终效果。
[/size]
[size=4]食用愉快~

[color=#ffff00]PS：再次强调请不要把我的mod二次上传到任何地方，QQ群也不行。N网不用翻墙，贴吧更是方便，

为什么还要二传QAQ
[/color][/size][size=3]
——————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
花了一周时间完成了这组服饰，里面包括了：[/size]

[size=3]三件袄裙，三件齐胸襦裙，两款嫁衣上衣，七件对应下裙。[/size]

[size=3]四款头发，三种样式不同的头饰（多种颜色）[/size]

[size=3]头饰衣服下装还有头发有的可以对应成一套，也可以自由搭配。[/size]

[size=3]物品名字和描述全中文，也有英语翻译，虽然很蹩脚_(:з」∠)_[/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=4]使用说明：[/size][/color]

[size=3]1.因为JA这个前置本身的bug，穿戴了这些服装在存档界面人物衣服贴图会消失或者错乱。但游戏里是完全正常的。[/size]

[size=3]2.这些衣服尤其是下裙，是基于[/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2718][u][size=4]Ran‘s Fancy Farmer[/size] [/u][/url][size=3]制作的，如果用其他人模贴图可能会出现问题。[/size]

[size=3]3.[s]头发是一张放在文件夹里的png图片[/s]。另一个发型文件里是一张png图片，因为JA并不能增加发型，而我来做成CP或者XNB很可能会覆盖掉你喜欢的头发。所以需要自行合并。[/size]

[size=3]4.用Get Glam换装，大概是Get Glam自身的缘故或者我自己的mod冲突，腿部贴图会错乱。[/size]

[size=3]5.可以自改自用但[color=#ffff00]没有我的允许[/color]请不要二次上传。[/size]

[size=3]最后，如果你喜欢的话，我可以准备开启制作男性传统服饰的计划 0 v 0 ![/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=4]安装说明：[/size][/color]
[size=3]
1. 需要前置SMAPI，CP和JA。[/size]
[size=3]
2.下载并解压文件。[/size]
[size=3]
3. 将文件夹放入Mods文件夹里即可。[/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=3]4.除了帽子可以在帽子商店买到，JA添加的衣服和下装目前无法通过正常途径获取，需要下载CJB直接拿取。[u][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB的N网界面[/url][/u][/size][/color]
[color=#ff7700][size=3]
PS:关于发型的合并， 还有上面提到的人模下载下来也是一些图片需要自己转换成mod（XNB和CP均可，甚至可以做成Get Glam的文件使用），[/size]可以去贴吧看看，贴吧的精品贴以及我自己的帖子（ID芝士味手抓饼）都有教程。有不懂可以去贴吧找我（N网输入法有点蛋疼_(:з」∠)_）[/color]

I’m here to update._(:з」∠)_

[color=#ff7700]Important[/color]：This update is [color=#ff7700]not included clothes[/color]！！！Just [color=#ff7700]8 hats and 3 hairstyles[/color]！！！

The preview is for showing hair and hats.It doesn't represent the ultimate effect of clothing.

Besides,I corrected the name of "Wintersweet upper coat".

Have fun :D[/size][size=4]
——————————————————————————————————————————————————————————————
First of all，I apologize for my poor English，some of the following nouns may be inaccurate > <[/size]


[size=3]It took me a week to complete this mod , which include:

three coat skirt upper coats, three Tang-style skirt upper coats, two wedding coats, and seven corresponding lower skirts.

four hairstyles，three different styles of headwear（Multiple color）

Headwears, coats, skirts and hairstyles can be mapped into a suit or collocate for your own like.

These objects' name and description are written by Chinese，and I translated them into English. But it‘’s not very accurate,sorry for my poor English again_(:з」∠)_

[/size][color=#ffff00][size=4]Explanation:
[/size][/color][size=3]1. Because of JsonAssets intrinsic BUG,in save page character's sprites will lose clothes if wear these clothes,.But it's all right in the game.

2.these clothes especially lower skirts are base on the body[u] [/u][/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2718][size=4][u]Ran's Fancy Farmer[/u][/size][/url][size=4]. [/size][size=3]It's may have some mistake with using other body or shoes.[/size]

[size=3]3.[s]hairstyles is a png which I put in the folder[/s]. Another file is a hairstyles' picture.Because it's maybe will replaces some hairstyles you like if I make them to CP or XNB.You could add them to game by yourself.

4.When I change dress by Get Glam, there is some bug with character's legs, I don't know why. : (

5.Just could edit this mod for yourself use.Please don't re-upload anywhere else[color=#ffff00] without my permission[/color].

[/size][size=4]Finally, if you like this mod, I will plan to make costumes for male character. 0 v 0![/size]

[color=#ffff00][size=4]Installs：[/size][/color]
[size=3]1.This mod need SMAPI, CP and JA

2.Download this file and unzip it.

3.Put the folder in "Mods".
[/size][size=3]
[color=#ffff00]4.Except hats are available at hat shops, shirts and pants which add by JA can't be available in the normal way.You could get them by CJB. [u] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB’Nexus page[/url][/u][/color]

[color=#ff7700]PS:About the hairstyles and the body mod（Ran’s Fancy Farmer）are some pictures which need to turn to CP or XNB version, even Get Glam's file by yourself. If you don't know how to do it, please tell me and I will help you.[/color]
[/size]
